reviewer: AI (Claude) independent reviewers (blind solve + informed review), separate from the author; not a native-speaker or teacher review

set.q:
A: How can I get to the post office?
B: ___
o: It is open every day, from nine to six.
Go straight, and turn left at the hospital.
Yes, I have a letter to send today.
The post office is very old and very big.
set.why: 길을 묻는 말에는 가는 방법을 말해 줘요. “Go straight, and turn left at the hospital.”이 길 안내예요.

patches.why: 오답 길이를 키워 길이 단서 제거(q 동일, o만 변경).

set.q: The answer is “Yes, it is next to the post office.” Which question fits?
o: Is the bus stop next to the post office?
Where is the bus stop, please?
Who is waiting at the post office?
When does the next bus come here?
set.why: Yes로 시작하는 대답이므로 Yes/No로 묻는 “Is the bus stop next to the post office?”가 알맞아요.

set.q:
Mina: I am at the bus stop. Where are you?
Jun: I am in front of the bakery.
Mina: I see it! It is across the street from me.

Where is the bakery?
o: Across the street from the bus stop.
Behind the bus stop, near the bank.
Next to Jun's house on Pine Street.
Inside the bus stop, out of the rain.
set.why: 미나가 버스 정류장에 있고 빵집이 길 건너편에 있다고 했어요.

set.q:
In Jun's room, the clock is on the wall above the bed. The shoes are next to the door. The robot is between the bed and the desk.

Where is the robot?
o: Next to the door, with the shoes.
On the wall, above the bed.
Between the bed and the desk.
Under the bed, with the shoes.

set.q:
In our kitchen, the milk is in the fridge. The bread is on the table. The cups are in the cupboard. The apples are in a bowl next to the bread.

Where are the apples?
o: In a bowl next to the bread.
In the fridge, next to the milk.
In the cupboard, with the cups.
Under the table, by the bread.
set.why: 사과는 빵 옆에 있는 그릇 안에 있어요.

set.q:
A: Is the bus stop far from here?
B: ___
o: It comes at ten o'clock every day.
Two tickets to the museum, please.
Because I like the red bus.
No, it is just across the street.
set.why: far(멀리)인지 묻는 말에 “No, it is just across the street.”(아니요, 바로 길 건너예요)가 알맞아요.

set.q:
Notice: Lost your way? Ask at the desk next to the front door. Maps are on the wall behind the desk.

Where are the maps?
o: On the desk next to the front door.
On the wall behind the desk.
In front of the desk.
Under the desk.
set.why: “Maps are on the wall behind the desk.”라고 쓰여 있어요.

set.rule: 장소를 물을 때는 Where 다음에 is와 주어를 차례로 써요. toy shop은 하나이므로 is예요.

cz.st: Excuse me, how can I get ___ the museum?

patches.why: 'Go twice to the park' 가능성 제거.

set.q: “Cross the street and walk to the park.”의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
o: 길을 건너서 공원까지 걸어가세요.
길을 따라 공원까지 달려가세요.
공원에서 길을 건너 집으로 가세요.
길 끝에서 공원을 지나 멈추세요.
set.why: cross the street는 길을 건너라는 뜻이고, walk to the park는 공원까지 걸어가라는 뜻이에요.

patches.why: corner 어휘 문항 반복 제거. 정체성 필드 q/o를 변경함.
